name: GTM & Revenue Operations
description: Go-to-market, revenue and marketing operations — the people who own the systems and data behind a sales org.
notes: Entries wrapped in slashes are regexes; plain entries are phrases matched on whole words.

Nothing here is required — delete any row that doesn't fit how you search.
